reuse.why: Routes every amount resolution (preview, posting, action sync, forecast, schedule template, API model, balance) through the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies and leaves a single definition; no new duplicated logic.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other schedule helpers, and the API field is computed in the api-models mapper.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field; the step-1 consolidation of the copies is directly in service of the rule change, though display callers that omit op are left implicitly on the range rule.

maintainability.why: One small, tested helper with named worst-case sub-functions; the only wart is call sites passing a positional `false` for inverse to reach the new op parameter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all former inline copies now call getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: none; the midpoint copies are deleted, not reshaped

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts gains one `op` parameter for the approximate case (a genuine variation of the rule); no special-case branches, and every caller goes through it
